mapper.sql: id, topic_id, topic_title, user_id, right_flag, reward_amount, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT trs.topic_id FROM topic_record_single trs INNER JOIN user_wallet uw ON uw.user_id = trs.user_id AND uw.type = 1 INNER JOIN user_wallet_record uwr ON uwr.wallet_id = uw.id AND uwr.event_id = trs.id AND uwr.event_type = 7 WHERE trs.right_flag = 1 AND trs.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT trs.id FROM topic_record_single trs INNER JOIN user_wallet uw ON uw.user_id = trs.user_id AND uw.type = 1 INNER JOIN user_wallet_record uwr ON uwr.wallet_id = uw.id AND uwr.event_id = trs.id AND uwr.event_type = 7 WHERE trs.right_flag = 1 AND trs.user_id = #{userId} AND trs.topic_id = #{topicId} LIMIT 1
